reference_word_attribution: interpolated from the sealed per-window reference-word COUNTS and window timings of SAEA-E21-MF-WINDOW-PAIRING-V1; exact at every window boundary, linear inside one. An attribution, never a timestamped alignment, and no reference text, wer_tags sidecar or timestamp file was opened.

rules.text_ownership: saea-obs-context-ownership-v1: the delivered text of a unit is its OWN turn's transcription only; each boundary is resolved once, on the overlap both neighbours transcribed

source_plan.turns_are_unchanged: every unit's span, speaker facts, cut kinds, flags, absorbed slivers and reference-word range are this file's, asserted field by field by the builder before the plan was written

zero_contact: no frozen core, diarizer re-run, GPU, embedder, tokenizer, network or paid API; no MP3 decode and no resample, so ffmpeg stays absent. The only audio touch is a local PCM read of already-sealed slices, reduced to 20 ms frame energies and thrown away.
